7.8.2.1 Authenticity of QSEvs
IdsM can optionally protect the authenticity of QSEvs using cryptographic au-
thenticator generated by the Csm in conjunction with the crypto stack. It can be
used to ensure authenticity as well as to prove integrity of messages from the
IdsM via all communication systems until reaching the Backend or SOC (End2End-
Security).
[SWS_IdsM_01204] Authenticating QSEv
Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00505, RS_Ids_00630
⌈The IdsM shall be able to attach a cryptographic authenticator, with the same
data format, to each QSEv. The authentication feature is optional and shall be
activated or deactivated globally for all QSEvs by setting the parameter IdsMAuthen-
ticatorSupport to TRUE or FALSE.⌋
[SWS_IdsM_01205] AuthenticatorLength
Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00505, RS_Ids_00630
⌈The IdsM’s parameter IdsMAuthenticatorLength shall define the length in bytes
of the authenticator calculated by the crypto services. It shall be configured when
the authentication feature is activated.⌋
The IdsM’s Csm Job IdsMCsmJobReference has two different types of authenti-
cation processing: synchronous and asynchronous. This processing is configured in
the Csm Job Primitive linked to the Csm Job, and determines the internal handling of
the IdsM for the authentication.
[SWS_IdsM_01206] GenerateAuthenticator
Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00505, RS_Ids_00630
